fields.q: 鸟吃鱼对吧？改天我给你抓条大的！
fields.en: Birds eat fish, right? I'll catch a big one for you sometime!
fields.name: 罗蕾塔

q.value: 鸟吃鱼对吧？改天我给你抓条大的！

en.value: Birds eat fish, right? I'll catch a big one for you sometime!

fields.q: 我不知道爸妈是谁，不过无所谓。现在过得好就行。
fields.en: I don't know who my parents are, but I don't really care. Things are good now. That's what matters.
fields.name: 罗蕾塔

q.value: 我不知道爸妈是谁，不过无所谓。现在过得好就行。

en.value: I don't know who my parents are, but I don't really care. Things are good now. That's what matters.

fields.q: 神殿里有个讨厌的家伙。他要是再欺负我，我就揍他。
fields.en: There's a horrible guy who I know from my temple. I'm going to punch him if he treats me badly again.
fields.name: 罗蕾塔

q.value: 神殿里有个讨厌的家伙。他要是再欺负我，我就揍他。

en.value: There's a horrible guy who I know from my temple. I'm going to punch him if he treats me badly again.

fields.q: 给神殿干活之前我偷过东西。被抓到就会挨罚，现在还留着伤疤呢。要看吗？
fields.en: I stole things before I worked for the temple. I'd get punished if caught and still have a scar. Wanna see?
fields.name: 罗蕾塔

q.value: 给神殿干活之前我偷过东西。被抓到就会挨罚，现在还留着伤疤呢。要看吗？

en.value: I stole things before I worked for the temple. I'd get punished if caught and still have a scar. Wanna see?

fields.q: 就算有点无聊，只要有地方睡、有饭吃，我就没什么好抱怨的。
fields.en: Even if it gets kinda boring, I can't complain if I've got a place to sleep and enough to eat.
fields.name: 罗蕾塔

q.value: 就算有点无聊，只要有地方睡、有饭吃，我就没什么好抱怨的。

en.value: Even if it gets kinda boring, I can't complain if I've got a place to sleep and enough to eat.

fields.q: 你住在森林里对吧？那你说说……你怎么看鬼魂？
fields.en: You live in the forest, right? So tell me… how do you feel about ghosts?
fields.name: 罗蕾塔

q.value: 你住在森林里对吧？那你说说……你怎么看鬼魂？

en.value: You live in the forest, right? So tell me… how do you feel about ghosts?

fields.q: 学用刀总比坐在教室里念书强。我说得对……对吧？
fields.en: It's better to learn how to use a blade than sit around in a classroom learning stuff. I'm right… right?
fields.name: 罗蕾塔

q.value: 学用刀总比坐在教室里念书强。我说得对……对吧？

en.value: It's better to learn how to use a blade than sit around in a classroom learning stuff. I'm right… right?

fields.q: 我最爱甜食了。改天给你带我最喜欢的怎么样？
fields.en: I love sweets. How about I bring you my favorites sometime?
fields.name: 罗蕾塔

q.value: 我最爱甜食了。改天给你带我最喜欢的怎么样？

fields.q: 欧辛教了我防身术。我想变得更强，让他不用再担心我！
fields.en: Ozin taught me how to defend myself. Now I want to be strong enough, so he doesn't have to worry!
fields.name: 罗蕾塔

fields.q: 我现在过得挺开心的。但我很挂念以前一起流浪街头的孤儿朋友们……
fields.en: I'm pretty happy with my life now. But my heart goes out to my ol' street-orphan friends…
fields.name: 罗蕾塔
